issue: An older loadedWorlds completion overwrites then removes the newer active session, permanently preventing its pending chance refresh.
scenario: Root independent JUnit proof: request A holds loadedWorlds; newer request B opens the list and loot page with pending cache. A completes, sessions.put(A) replaces B before openTracked refuses the stale epoch; remove(A) leaves no registered session. Cache publishes, current B still shows calculating: expected one in-place update, actual zero. 2-test proof run15s, this case failed at expected1/actual0 with no errors. Still fails on fix2/2ad2057: host3tests1failure0errors0skips55s; always and changing-source cases now pass.
basis: Issue112: a page open while chances were not ready refreshes in place when they arrive if the same player still has that page open. ADR0010 single-operation state and task stale-page guard. The current B page is still physically open, and refusing stale A must not unregister it.

issue: 3.both.1: A missing back layout item keeps its barrier but loses the back action, so the back button on a loot page does nothing.
scenario: Configure the wiki loot page's back item as not_an_item, open the list, click a loot, then click the missing-back barrier at slot 9: no list open happens and the player stays on the loot page. On the previous commit the same click ran session::showList.
basis: Phase 9 line 211: "A loot page shows the loot's contents, an info item, and a back button." The fix adds isMissingIcon to the back branch but skips the whole put, including the showList action that worked before.

issue: 3.both.2: A failed loot open still leaves the session on the loot page if a list page turn advanced the revision, so the later chance refresh overwrites the still-open list.
scenario: Open a paged list, hold opens, click a loot, click next page before the open finishes, then refuse the open: openFailed sees revision != attempt, keeps state.lootPage, and chancesReady refreshes the list with loot contents.
basis: Issue #112: a not-ready page refreshes in place only "if the same player still has that page open". The fix's own test covers two failed opens, but a list page turn between the click and the failure still leaves the optimistic loot page.
